level_description: Recursive Structures & FSM Stress Traps (4+ level deep nested objects, extreme topological inversion, and multi-tier calculation rollups designed to trigger FSM state explosion and LLM arithmetic failure)

L4_org_hierarchy_rollup.name: Corporate Hierarchy Budget Rollup
L4_org_hierarchy_rollup.description: A 4-deep organizational chart. The total corporate budget is declared at the root, but mathematically depends on salaries bubbling up from ICs -> Managers -> Directors -> VPs -> CEO.

prompts.system: You are an enterprise HR system generating departmental budget reports. Output ONLY raw, valid JSON.
prompts.user: Generate a full corporate hierarchy budget. Include headcount and salaries for all levels, and accurately calculate the total corporate budget rollup.

L4_data_center_topology.name: Data Center Power & Cooling Cascade
L4_data_center_topology.description: A 4-deep physical infrastructure model (Facility -> Row -> Rack -> Blade). Leaf-node power draw cascades upward into intermediate rack totals, row kW conversions, and final facility-wide PUE overheads.

prompts.system: You are a data center facility management system. Output ONLY raw, valid JSON.
prompts.user: Generate a power draw report for a data center facility. Start from server blade wattage, calculate rack and row aggregations, and compute total facility power usage.
